closure: Full author mathematical body retained. Complete Theorem3.2 quotient/relative-projectivity proof, original moduli setup and stated Simpson quotient prerequisites are retained. Named GIT descent, compactified Hitchin positivity and openness of ampleness remain exact references; the new equivariant family and boundary-twisted relative ample bundle are not treated as known. Later P=W/moduli cohomology claims remain context only.
current_difficulty_reason: The named Simpson properness theorem does not itself construct a projective compactification of the whole Hodge family. Section3 builds the parameter-compatible equivariant quotient, identifies its open Hodge moduli locus and controls the descended line bundle on the zero fiber by the compactified Hitchin map. The boundary twist and comparison with the trivial nonzero-parameter family then close relative ampleness; these source-specific constructions remain required after the cited GIT and ampleness foundations are allowed.
